# EOTC Calendar Data Dictionary

Master research dataset for the Tewahedo Daily Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church calendar.

**Location:** `research/eotc-calendar/`  
**Encoding:** UTF-8 with BOM (UTF-8-SIG)  
**Generated by:** `scripts/build-eotc-calendar-research.mjs`

## Design principles

1. **Ethiopian date is authoritative** for fixed commemorations (`ethiopian_month_number` + `ethiopian_day`).
2. **Gregorian dates are computed at runtime** for a chosen Ethiopian year — not stored as permanent fixed civil dates.
3. **Synaxarium commemorations ≠ Calendar Cards.** Cards remain curated in `public.calendar_cards`.
4. **Weekly Wednesday/Friday fasting is not a Synaxarium feast.** It belongs in `eotc-fasts.csv` / fasting status.
5. **Do not invent Amharic, scripture, or anaphora links.** Blank fields mean unverified.
6. **Confidence + sources are required** for every substantive claim.

## Mapping to existing Supabase tables

| Research file | Preferred live table | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `eotc-calendar-days.csv` | `public.synaxarium_days` | One row per Ethiopian day (incl. Pagumen 6). |
| `eotc-commemorations.csv` | `public.synaxarium_commemorations` | Multiple rows per day; monthly expanded rows included. |
| `eotc-feasts.csv` | `public.feasts` | Reusable feast definitions; do not duplicate full Synaxarium bodies. |
| `eotc-saints.csv` | `public.saints` | Reusable person records; link from commemorations later. |
| `eotc-fasts.csv` | propose `public.fasts` | No dedicated table today; keep separate from commemorations. |
| `eotc-liturgical-seasons.csv` | propose `public.liturgical_seasons` | Optional; only if seasons cannot live as metadata. |
| `eotc-monthly-commemorations.csv` | catalog / seed helper | Templates for day-of-month expansion. |
| `eotc-movable-feasts.csv` | rules + runtime computus | Store offsets; compute annual civil/Ethiopian dates. |
| `eotc-calendar-sources.csv` | research metadata | Traceability; not necessarily a prod table. |
| — | `public.calendar_cards` | **Do not auto-create** from Synaxarium rows. |
| — | `public.daily_content` | Optional editorial “Today” overlays. |
| — | `public.mezmur` / tags | Use feast/saint/occasion tags for recommendations only when metadata matches. |
| — | `public.liturgy_*` | Link only when a **documented** rule exists. |

### Suggested safe migrations (only if importing)

- `synaxarium_days`: optional `season`, `fasting_status`, `major_feast`, `confidence`, `needs_review`, `source_ids`
- `synaxarium_commemorations`: optional `title_transliteration`, `source_reference`, `confidence`, `needs_review`, `is_monthly` (if not already present)
- New `public.fasts` and optionally `public.liturgical_seasons` as described in the research report
- **Do not** delete existing Synaxarium or calendar_cards data

---

## File: `eotc-calendar-days.csv`

One row per Ethiopian calendar day (366 = 12×30 + Pagumen 6).

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| slug | text | e.g. `meskerem-01` |
| ethiopian_month | text | Canonical English month name |
| ethiopian_month_number | int | 1–13 |
| ethiopian_day | int | 1–30 (Pagumen 1–6) |
| display_date_english | text | Human label |
| display_date_amharic | text | Verified Amharic only; often blank |
| summary | text | Short day summary from Synaxarium extract |
| season | text | Best-effort liturgical season label(s) |
| fasting_status | text | Day-level fast flag when known (often blank pending computus) |
| major_feast | text | Major feast title if fixed feast lands on day |
| source_page_start / end | int/text | Synaxarium PDF page hints |
| status | text | draft / published |
| confidence | high/medium/low | |
| needs_review | bool | |
| synaxarium_id | text | Source extract id |
| source_ids | text | Pipe-separated source keys |

---

## File: `eotc-commemorations.csv`

Daily Synaxarium rows **plus** expanded monthly commemorations.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| slug | Unique row id |
| day_slug | Parent day |
| title / title_amharic / title_transliteration / title_geez | Names; Amharic/Ge'ez only when verified |
| commemoration_type | christ, mary, trinity, holy-spirit, angel, saint, martyr, apostle, prophet, feast, miracle, church-event, other |
| summary | Short |
| body_english / body_amharic | Full body — intentionally sparse (copyright / verification) |
| short_card_summary | 1–3 sentence user-facing card |
| full_explanation | Longer explanation when available |
| scripture_references | Only when present in source; **OCR/extract needs verification** |
| is_monthly | true for monthly expansions |
| fixed_date / movable | |
| confidence / needs_review / source_reference | Traceability |

---

## File: `eotc-feasts.csv`

Reusable feast definitions (fixed / movable / monthly).

## File: `eotc-saints.csv`

Reusable saints, angels, apostles, martyrs for linking and search.

## File: `eotc-fasts.csv`

Seasonal and weekly fasts. Includes Wednesday/Friday as **fast discipline**, not Synaxarium events.

## File: `eotc-liturgical-seasons.csv`

Named seasons with start/end rules when documented in project sources.

## File: `eotc-monthly-commemorations.csv`

Day-of-month templates (1–30) with multi-source confidence.

## File: `eotc-movable-feasts.csv`

Bahire Hasab / Nineveh-anchored offsets. Annual civil dates must be computed; see research report.

## File: `eotc-calendar-sources.csv`

Source registry.

## File: `eotc-calendar-quality-report.csv`

Issues: missing Amharic, OCR scripture, conflicting monthly names, missing extracts, etc.

## File: `eotc-calendar-build-summary.json`

Machine-readable totals from the last build.
